categories.name: daos.fun Ecosystem
categories.content: daos.fun Ecosystem consists of tokens that have active hedge funds on daos.fun.

categories.name: Kumbaya Launchpad
categories.content: Kumbaya is a community-first DEX and launchpad designed as a high-performance hub for 'cult' tokens and cultural assets.

categories.name: topblast.lol Ecosystem
categories.content: topblast.lol is a launchpad on The Open Network (TON), integrating fair-launch mechanics with a comprehensive Telegram-native DeFi ecosystem.

categories.name: Tourism
categories.content: A coin or token that leverages blockchain technology to improve various aspects of the tourism industry.

categories.name: Duck-Themed
categories.content: Meme coins which are inspired by duck.

categories.name: Gaming Marketplace
categories.content: A platform where players can buy, sell, or trade in-game assets, currencies, or digital items.

categories.name: Printr Launchpad
categories.content: Printr is chain-abstracted token launchpad with customizable fee models and an on-chain 'Proof of Belief' staking mechanism that rewards long-term community commitment.

categories.name: Reserve Ecosystem
categories.content: Decentralized Token Folio (DTF) issued and created with the Reserve protocol's open-source contracts (developed by ABC Labs).

categories.name: Long Launchpad
categories.content: Tokens launched through LONG (https://x.com/longdotxyz), a token launchpad on Robinhood Chain whose defining feature is that every launch trades against a Robinhood Stock Token.

categories.name: Move To Earn
categories.content: The move-to-earn model is often implemented through mobile applications that use technologies such as GPS tracking to monitor users' physical activity. These apps then reward users with tradable tokens or NFTs based on the distance they cover or the number of steps they take.

categories.name: Zora Creator
categories.content: Zora Creator Coins are profile-level tokens on the Zora platform, a blockchain-based social network focused on the creator economy. Each Zora account has its own unique Creator Coin, represented by the user's username as the ticker symbol (e.g., $username).

categories.name: Four.Meme Tokenized Stocks (4Stock)
categories.content: Tokens issued by Four.Meme under its 4Stock product. Each 4Stock is intended to be backed by its corresponding underlying share, purchased and held by Four.Meme through a dedicated managed account.

categories.name: Metagovernance
categories.content: Metagovernance refers to projects or protocols that primarily hold DAO tokens and actively participates in the governance process of those DAOs.

categories.name: Decentralized Lottery
categories.content: A decentralized lottery is a blockchain-based lottery system that conducts draws through smart contracts.

categories.name: Sports Games
categories.content: Sports game simulates the playing of real-world sports including sports such as football, badminton and basketball.

categories.name: Pump Fund Portfolio
categories.content: Projects and tokens officially backed by Pump Fund, the venture arm of Pump.fun. These projects are selected for their adherence to "build in public" principles, transparent development, and verified founder commitment.

categories.name: RWAfi
categories.content: Protocols whose core product is DeFi functionality built on top of tokenized real-world assets issued by third parties. Where RWA Protocols handle issuance, these protocols take an already-tokenized asset as input and make it financially productive: separating an asset's yield from its principal, lending against it as collateral, providing or managing its liquidity, constructing baskets from it, or routing value into it. Protocols in this category represent a claim on protocol activity and are not themselves backed by real-world assets.

categories.name: Rollup
categories.content: Rollup is a layer 2 solution that aggregates and processes transactions outside of a main blockchain, before submitting them as a single batch, to enhance scalability and reduce fees.

categories.name: Guild and Scholarship
categories.content: Guilds are decentralized autonomous organizations (DAOs) that invests in NFTs like game assets and rent them out to players. Players who receive rented game items are known as scholars and can be said to receive a scholarship. Guilds are an important component in the play to earn (P2E) ecosystem as these games require an upfront investment capital for players to participate in.
